fusions.name: Hatching Burst
fusions.desc: Hurls a ball of raw arcana that deals 30 damage to the first enemy it meets, then bursts, hitting every enemy within 3 tiles for 80% of that. You move 20% faster for 4 seconds after throwing it.

fusions.name: Lens Flicker
fusions.desc: A flick of arcana that deals 4 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at its full reach of 5 tiles, with a 25% chance to leave the target [Exposed] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Unrippled Mind
fusions.desc: Restores 3 mana a second for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Brimming Pond
fusions.desc: The moment your mana is full, your next spell deals 30% more damage. Once every 12 seconds.
